protocol.question: On the fixed spatial reaching task, what do actual PPO/SAC learning, replay reuse and an excessive PPO learning rate do under disclosed CPU budgets?
protocol.evaluation: Frozen tanh(mean)*physical_scale. Same five initial-state seeds at each evaluation. Continuing fixed target task, not generalization to other targets. Report return, mean/final distance, fraction of steps under .04m, final-32-step mean, wall time, interaction and optimizer counts.
protocol.analysis: Retain every seed and failed run. Median/IQR/range and paired per-seed differences at equal interaction budgets; descriptive only, no p-values or efficacy claim. PPO vs SAC are not equal-compute comparisons. Poor outcomes are valid. No selecting best seed for headline.
protocol.mechanisms: At five independent seeds, controlled ReLU neuron inactivation (zero incoming weights, bias -100) versus restoration at identical stored batch/noise; compare activations and actual actor gradients. This is induced inactivity, not evidence that ordinary training necessarily produces dormant neurons.
protocol.stop: Per-run hard budget 3600 seconds; record timeout/failed status and partial data. No silent retries or extensions. Pilot uses seed999 outside study and 512 interactions solely for timing, excluded from results.

sac_reuse4_minus_reuse1.interpretation: negative favors right condition; paired training seeds, descriptive only

ppo_large_minus_reference.interpretation: negative favors right condition; paired training seeds, descriptive only

limitations: Fixed target and five held-out initial-state seeds; no new-target or real-hardware claim.
Five training seeds are the descriptive replication unit; 25 evaluation episodes are not 25 independent trained policies.
Training ran with two single-threaded learners initially and concurrent build/test work; wall times are observed inclusive times, not isolated algorithm speed benchmarks.

Sources changed during long process lifetime only in import budget, trace derivative labels and temperature validation. Learner formulas unchanged. See deterministic fresh-process rerun evidence; per-run Git labels alone do not identify all loaded modules.
No p-values, confidence intervals or educational efficacy are inferred. All preregistered runs retained.
